message.content: {"winner":"B","evidence_A":"Clean join ('a lot of time'), roughly 95 words, informal first-person voice. Development stays abstract ('several choices', 'more than one way in') and names no translation. Ends in padded filler ('for my present purposes in these particular matters'). Mild invention ('what the later editors had been after') is vague.","evidence_B":"Joins with 'most of my summer', about 120 words. Gives concrete detail: Geneva marginal commentary, a conversational RSV, and the tradeoff against KJV's 'sweep'. 'Summer' is an invented personal detail. Calling Geneva a 'newer version' is inaccurate. Closing lines lean tidy, and the voice drifts into second person.","comparative_reason":"B develops the comparison of translations with specific examples and weighs readability against literary influence. It has a minor factual slip and an invented detail. A is vague and closes on awkward filler. B's substance outweighs its flaws."}
